Interior is shaded neutral grey with ordinary reflective metal machinery, never warm yellow illumination. All green glass is dark non-emissive bottle-green; no luminous fill, bloom, halo, colored spill, artificial light sources or dramatic lighting anywhere. Brass may have ordinary neutral studio reflections but must not emit light. Render a matte off-white background and soft neutral contact shadow. Entire building inside the square frame with clear margin. 

REFERENCE PRIORITY: image 4 is the corrected T01 family anchor; image 5 when present is the corrected immediately previous accepted tier and is the PRIMARY cumulative geometry reference. Preserve its existing functional volumes and add the current large architectural upgrade. For T00 derive repairable damage from image 4 only. Images 1-3 are palette/material inspiration only, not building layouts or lighting examples. CURRENT UPGRADE: add exactly ONE new VERTICAL GREEN-GLASS MIXING CORE on the REAR CENTRAL process mass, structurally supported above the retained rear tank hall. One tall wide cylindrical chamber with thick dark bottle-green glass, broad cream/brass frame posts, a low flat cream technical lid and neutral-grey internal mixing paddles visible through the glass. ALL GLASS MUST BE DARK AND NON-EMISSIVE with no luminous fill or glow. Do not add a second glass core yet. Preserve three front storeys and PV hood, two opaque left mixers and hygiene tower, large right manifold/buffer and three small tanks. Keep the whole tall silhouette inside frame.

Asset type: one final Meshy image-to-3D building reference for Weedtopia Inc / Burning Hills.

Progression: Preserve the T01 family DNA and the previously accepted tier. Integrate previous functional capacity compactly upward and rearward, inside the reserved parcel. Current cumulative architectural milestones: repaired mixing hall with two round tanks; large third food-grade tank; broad enclosed ingredient intake; rear mixing-machine hall; add a large rounded cream mixing-hall roof hood above the retained main processing plant; second large mixing vessel; add a broad enclosed process-and-maintenance bridge above the rear mixing hall, above the original tank pipework; broad solar roof above mixing hall; large rounded butter buffer tank; second tall mixing vessel; broad clean packing wing; complete second processing storey; rear compact tank hall; tall rounded hygiene core; large shared output collector; third compact processing storey; vertical thick green-glass mixing core. No separate freestanding buildings: all wings and modules are structurally attached.
Scale: maximum reserved parcel 20m local X by 18m local Z, maximum family height 28m. This reserved envelope is NOT a visible base. See asset_spec.de.md for this tier's approximate occupied dimensions; render the whole current object, not an empty full-size plot.
Front and camera: local +Y up, front facing +Z, front stays on the lower-left visible face of the image, local +X side on lower-right. Camera at local (+X,+Y,+Z), about 35 degrees elevated, near orthographic 3/4 front view. Never mirror. Ground-center pivot intent; future growth is upward and toward local -Z. The entry and delivery zones stay on +Z.
Materials: cream enamel, sage enamel, brass, restrained thick green glass; epoch treatment: oxidized copper, thick green glass, cream plaster, compact solar technology. Broad hand-painted color areas and large restrained wear patches. Rounded/beveled silhouettes, thick reconstructable parts, modular retro technology, one or at most two eventual material slots. Green glass must be thick and legible. At most one dominant botanical or grinder motif.
Reference input roles: Image 1 Reclaimed Green Haven gives warm rebuilt shapes and readability; image 2 Herbal Atom Age gives rounded enamel machines and copper/brass; image 3 Burning Hills Afterglow gives hopeful worldbuilding only, NOT its dusk lighting, environment or people. Additional inputs, when present: the family's accepted T01 geometry anchor, then its immediately preceding accepted tier. Preserve their family identity, front and proportions while making the specified large upgrade visible. For T00 use only the intact T01 as extra geometry reference. For T01 or T_FIXED only the three style inputs are supplied.
Composition: exactly one single complete freestanding asset, centered and grounded; square 1024x1024 or larger, generous 10 percent clear margin all around. Plain solid very light warm-gray/off-white background. Neutral even studio light; one soft contact shadow only. All geometry entirely visible.
Technical intent: stylized game-ready smart-topology, clean edges, minimal geometry; no floating parts. Attached architectural planting is allowed; no loose props. A park may contain its intrinsic bounded planted parcel, never a surrounding scenic diorama.
Exclude: people, characters, vehicles, conveyor belts, surrounding scene, landscape, city, unrelated buildings, loose props, diorama ground, text, readable signs, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, weapons, gore, smoking, smoke, particles, thin antennae, tangled cables, clipped or cropped geometry, baked dramatic shadows, glows, fog or dusk color casts.
